Groups items from a primary list into branches based on similar string keys, and groups corresponding items from additional lists into the same branches. Branch-aware: grouping applies per input branch.

**Panel:** Comma → Data · **Nickname:** `GrpKeys`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keys | `K` | Text | Tree |  | String keys used for grouping (branch-aware) |
| Values A | `A` | Generic | Tree |  | Values to group alongside keys; must align with keys per branch |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Grouped Keys | `K` | Text | Tree | Key string for each output branch |
| Grouped Values A | `A` | Generic | Tree | Grouped values corresponding to keys |
